protocol.read_metric: executed reference-read commands and visible content lower bounds; never count inventories as reads
protocol.cost_metric: task elapsed_ms and reported tokens used; parent end-to-end wall and stage intervals, no unavailable parent-token inference
protocol.acceptance: unchanged oracle plus own tests; spec bytes and original test method AST unchanged; no scope expansion or parent rescue
protocol.timing_control: sequential consumers, no concurrent coverage/broad-suite execution
protocol.decision_rule: No tuning, rescue or replacement runs. Both B cells must pass all same capability/path/scope checks; each B must show fewer unnecessary content reads and lower reported tokens than its matched A (A1/B1, B2/A2). Otherwise reject or call inconclusive and keep source unchanged. Timing is descriptive only.
nonclaims: not a public-skill improvement if effect belongs to fixture instruction
no total monetary/model-cost claim without parent token telemetry
two pairs do not establish general performance
protocol.primary_read_metric: Content reads of spec SKILL/spec references or conditional impl/Prove bodies without a contract change; inventories and existence checks excluded. Mandatory reads and path resolution remain required.

parent_refinements: omit treatment-only reporting instruction to avoid changing output requirements
omit hardcoded conditional-reference exclusion list; preserve skill judgment
